job: Between patients, wipe down the high-touch ledges in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the ledge at the reception desk in the waiting room.
understood_as: Between patient visits, wipe down two high-touch surfaces in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the reception desk ledge in the waiting room.
steps: Move to the waiting room and wipe the reception desk ledge.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and how firmly to press when wiping a narrow ledge or sill.
Shows how hard to grip the cloth so it does not slip or bunch up while pressing and wiping.

questions: Should the cloth be wet with disinfectant? The robot can only wipe with a cloth. It cannot spray or apply cleaning product, so someone would need to prepare or swap the cloth.
Where will the clean cloth be kept, and who swaps it for a fresh one between patients? No spot for the cloth has been located in the building.
How will the robot know a patient has left? Nothing in the current setup detects this, so please say whether staff will start each run or it should run on a fixed schedule.
